docs.plugin.emoji-rain.summary: Configure the emoji list, optional OBS HUD resolution, and a local test rain. This guide uses no TikTok connection and no production OBS scene.
docs.plugin.emoji-rain.firstResult: The test drops the selected emojis in the local HUD.

docs.plugin.emoji-rain.troubleshooting: If the test stays empty, enable Emoji Rain, save the configuration, and check that the browser source uses the exact local HUD URL.

Open /plugins/emoji-rain/ui.html, verify the state named in the symptom, then repeat the local test. Use “➕ Add” (#add-user-mapping-btn) on /plugins/emoji-rain/ui.html to run its action. Interface declared in the plugin code: GET /api/emoji-rain/config.

docs.plugin.emoji-rain.steps.enable-emoj: Turn on the “Emoji Rain” switch. The plugin processes local test events only after it is enabled.
The status beside the switch reads “Enabled”.
docs.plugin.emoji-rain.steps.choose-emoj: Enter, for example, “💧, ✨, 🎉” in “Emojis (comma-separated)”. Each local test chooses only from this list.
The text area contains the three comma-separated demo emojis.
Choose the emoji list - Emoji Rain
docs.plugin.emoji-rain.steps.enable-obs-: Enable the OBS HUD for the test source
Enable “OBS HUD”. This only makes the separate local HUD page available; it does not start OBS or a stream.
The OBS HUD checkbox is selected.
Enable the OBS HUD for the test source - Emoji Rain
3. Enable the OBS HUD for the test source
docs.plugin.emoji-rain.steps.select-hud-: Choose “1080p (1920×1080)” for the tutorial scene, or the resolution planned for your browser source. Width and height must match in OBS.
The chosen preset is visible in the resolution menu.
Select the HUD resolution - Emoji Rain
docs.plugin.emoji-rain.steps.save-emoji-: Save the configuration in the test profile
Click “Save configuration”. The values are stored only in the isolated test profile.
After saving, the selected emoji and HUD state remain visible.
Save the configuration in the test profile - Emoji Rain
5. Save the configuration in the test profile
docs.plugin.emoji-rain.steps.run-local-r: Run the local Emoji Rain test
Click “Test Emoji Rain”. This button creates a local demo event; it sends nothing to TikTok and triggers no external hardware.
The real success notification confirms that the event was sent to the local HUD source.
Run the local Emoji Rain test - Emoji Rain

docs.plugin.emoji-rain.steps.verify-obs-: Verify the OBS HUD URL in Emoji Rain
Check the visible “Open OBS HUD” link, then use its URL in a temporary browser source in the non-live OBS test scene. Use the resolution selected above. Local overlay path: `/emoji-rain/obs-hud`.
The visible link points to the Emoji Rain HUD endpoint and the required settings remain in the same product surface.
Verify the OBS HUD URL in Emoji Rain

docs.plugin.openshock.summary: Hybridshock configures safety limit, queue, and device mapping with a safe local check instead of a LIVE trigger.
docs.plugin.openshock.firstResult: the flow is shown as a simulation and triggers no haptics
docs.plugin.openshock.requirements: LTTH Dashboard; hardware remains powered off or simulated. This Hybridshock workflow specifically covers safety limit, queue, and device mapping.
docs.plugin.openshock.safety: Do not trigger hardware: connection, printing, and haptics stay in demo or offline state. This Hybridshock workflow specifically covers safety limit, queue, and device mapping.
docs.plugin.openshock.troubleshooting: If safety limit, queue, and device mapping is not visible, first check the active plugin status, local route, and saved test values.
docs.plugin.openshock.purpose: Hybridshock configures safety limit, queue, and device mapping with a safe local check instead of a LIVE trigger.
docs.plugin.openshock.audience: Streamers who want to set up safety limit, queue, and device mapping without LIVE impact first.
docs.plugin.openshock.activation.navigat: Open “Hybridshock” in Plugin Manager, enable it when needed, then open its local configuration.
docs.plugin.openshock.workflows.golden-p: Set up Hybridshock in the test profile

docs.plugin.store-admin.title: LTTH App Store Admin
docs.plugin.store-admin.summary: LTTH App Store Admin configures store view, source approval, and package status with a safe local check instead of a LIVE trigger.
docs.plugin.store-admin.firstResult: the store shows the safe default state; no source is enabled
docs.plugin.store-admin.requirements: LTTH Dashboard and access to the local LTTH URL. This LTTH App Store Admin workflow specifically covers store view, source approval, and package status.
docs.plugin.store-admin.safety: Do not enter real API keys or accounts; placeholders stay placeholders. This LTTH App Store Admin workflow specifically covers store view, source approval, and package status.
docs.plugin.store-admin.troubleshooting: If store view, source approval, and package status is not visible, first check the active plugin status, local route, and saved test values.
docs.plugin.store-admin.purpose: LTTH App Store Admin configures store view, source approval, and package status with a safe local check instead of a LIVE trigger.
docs.plugin.store-admin.audience: Streamers who want to set up store view, source approval, and package status without LIVE impact first.
docs.plugin.store-admin.activation.navig: Open “LTTH App Store Admin” in Plugin Manager, enable it when needed, then open its local configuration.
docs.plugin.store-admin.workflows.golden: Set up LTTH App Store Admin in the test profile

docs.plugin.quiz-show.title: Pup Cid's Little Quiz Show Plugin
docs.plugin.quiz-show.summary: Pup Cid's Little Quiz Show Plugin configures question pool, answer time, and scoring logic with a safe local check instead of a LIVE trigger.
docs.plugin.quiz-show.firstResult: the game view shows the question without LIVE chat interaction
docs.plugin.quiz-show.requirements: LTTH Dashboard; use an OBS test scene for output. This Pup Cid's Little Quiz Show Plugin workflow specifically covers question pool, answer time, and scoring logic.
docs.plugin.quiz-show.safety: Use an OBS test scene that is not live; LIVE output remains disabled. This Pup Cid's Little Quiz Show Plugin workflow specifically covers question pool, answer time, and scoring logic.
docs.plugin.quiz-show.troubleshooting: If question pool, answer time, and scoring logic is not visible, first check the active plugin status, local route, and saved test values.
docs.plugin.quiz-show.purpose: Pup Cid's Little Quiz Show Plugin configures question pool, answer time, and scoring logic with a safe local check instead of a LIVE trigger.
docs.plugin.quiz-show.audience: Streamers who want to set up question pool, answer time, and scoring logic without LIVE impact first.
docs.plugin.quiz-show.activation.navigat: Open “Pup Cid's Little Quiz Show Plugin” in Plugin Manager, enable it when needed, then open its local configuration.
docs.plugin.quiz-show.workflows.golden-p: Set up Pup Cid's Little Quiz Show Plugin in the test profile

docs.plugin.webgpu-weather-control.steps: Check renderer status in the test profile
Open WebGPU Weather Control and inspect the status area before enabling effects. The isolated configuration is at /webgpu-weather-control/ui.
The status area of the dedicated WebGPU weather surface is visible.
Check renderer status in the test profile
/screenshots/docs/plugins/webgpu-weather-control/webgpu-weather-status.png
1. Check renderer status in the test profile
Keep adaptive quality on Auto
On /webgpu-weather-control/ui, review the “Quality preset” selector (#qualityPreset) and use Auto for the local 1080p60 preview.
The quality preset is visible and can remain on Auto for preview.
Keep adaptive quality on Auto
/screenshots/docs/plugins/webgpu-weather-control/webgpu-weather-quality.png
2. Keep adaptive quality on Auto
Start the cinematic rain preview locally
On /webgpu-weather-control/ui, click “Test Rain Effect” (#testRainEffectBtn). The test renders only a local WebGPU preview and sends no LIVE trigger.
The status area confirms that the local rain preview started.
Start the cinematic rain preview locally
/screenshots/docs/plugins/webgpu-weather-control/webgpu-weather-rain-preview.png
3. Start the cinematic rain preview locally
Review the community HUD separately
On /webgpu-weather-control/ui, inspect the separate “Show community info in overlay” toggle (#gamificationOverlayEnabled). Keep it disabled for the safe test preview.
The independent community HUD toggle is visible.
Review the community HUD separately
/screenshots/docs/plugins/webgpu-weather-control/webgpu-weather-community-hud.png
4. Review the community HUD separately
Use the WebGPU overlay URL for OBS
Review the visible URL in WebGPU Weather Control before using it in a non-live OBS test scene. Local overlay path: `/webgpu-weather-control/overlay`.
The visible overlay URL can be used for the OBS test source.
Use the WebGPU overlay URL for OBS
/screenshots/docs/plugins/webgpu-weather-control/webgpu-weather-overlay.png
5. Use the WebGPU overlay URL for OBS
Cleanly stop the local WebGPU preview
After testing, click “Stop All” (#stopAllPreviewBtn) on /webgpu-weather-control/ui. This stops preview effects only and does not change saved configuration.
The status area confirms that the local preview stopped.
Cleanly stop the local WebGPU preview
/screenshots/docs/plugins/webgpu-weather-control/webgpu-weather-preview-stop.png
6. Cleanly stop the local WebGPU preview
docs.plugin.streamalchemy.title: Stream Monsters
docs.plugin.streamalchemy.summary: Stream Monsters 1.8 combines creator-enabled gift eggs, optional recurring free eggs, 72 bundled Furry forms, permanent progression, and sealed A/B/C battles in a portrait-first arena.
docs.plugin.streamalchemy.firstResult: The Creator shows live readiness, gift and free eggs, all 72 forms, the sealed A/B/C arena, and the OBS browser source without triggering a LIVE action.
docs.plugin.streamalchemy.requirements: LTTH 1.4.1 with Stream Monsters 1.8. The Creator is enough for local setup; TikTok, GCCE, and OBS are needed only for broadcast operation.
docs.plugin.streamalchemy.safety: Use local previews only while checking the setup. Free eggs and gifts never change combat stats or win odds. Stream Monsters 1.8 includes no Art Lab, image generation, or model installer.
docs.plugin.streamalchemy.troubleshootin: If gifts, the 72 forms, or the A/B/C preview are missing, check the plugin status, reopen /streammonsters/ui, and review the Live Center warnings.
docs.plugin.streamalchemy.purpose: Stream Monsters 1.8 combines creator-enabled gift eggs, optional recurring free eggs, 72 bundled Furry forms, permanent progression, and sealed A/B/C battles in a portrait-first arena.

docs.plugin.streamalchemy.steps.alchemy-: Check the Live Center and broadcast readiness
Open the Stream Monsters Creator and review TikTok, GCCE, OBS, plugin, egg, arena, renderer, and audio status. Resolve visible warnings before going live.
The Live Center shows every relevant broadcast state in one view.
Stream Monsters 1.8 Live Center with broadcast status
1. Check the Live Center and broadcast readiness
docs.plugin.streamalchemy.steps.retentio: Check free eggs, sealed choices, and fair season rules

Recurring free eggs are optional: a 60 to 31,536,000 second cooldown defaults to 24 hours. First chat contact reserves the egg for 60 seconds; it then enters the public FIFO and can be claimed with !adopt. Battle choices stay sealed: 10 seconds for a monster, 6 seconds for A/B/C, and 15 seconds for 1–4 stat points. Striker, Guardian, Trickster, and Sustain use balanced elemental advantages. Daily and weekly quests require neither gifts nor wins; only the first 10 legitimate daily battles alter Arena Rating, while every legitimate battle grants monster XP.
Gameplay shows the free-egg cooldown, tutorial hints, fair roles, quests, and season boundaries.
Stream Monsters 1.8 gameplay with free eggs and sealed choices
2. Check free eggs, sealed choices, and fair season rules
docs.plugin.streamalchemy.steps.automati: Set up gifts-only eggs and chat aliases
Choose a gift from the complete TikTok gift catalog, assign Spawn or Boost and an element, then review conflict-free chat aliases. No egg is created without an enabled gift.
The Gifts & Chat view shows enabled gift mappings and the available egg, monster, and battle commands.
Stream Monsters 1.8 gifts-only eggs and chat aliases
3. Set up gifts-only eggs and chat aliases
docs.plugin.streamalchemy.steps.action-c: Review 24 templates with three verified Furry stages each. Evolution II requires mastery 25 and 3 essence spent; Evolution III requires mastery 50 and 8 total essence spent. Evolution remains cosmetic only.
The asset library confirms 72 bundled forms and the emergency Kenney fallback.
Stream Monsters 1.8 asset library with 72 Furry forms
docs.plugin.streamalchemy.steps.rule-dry: Check the interactive A/B/C arena in portrait
Review the 1080×1920 preview with two fighters, HP, special energy, and the A, B, and C actions. The lower 26 percent remains reserved as the TikTok chat safe zone.
The portrait preview shows the interactive A/B/C battle layout and reserved chat zone.
Stream Monsters 1.8 portrait arena with A/B/C actions
5. Check the interactive A/B/C arena in portrait
docs.plugin.streamalchemy.steps.alchemy-: Add the Stream Monsters overlay to OBS
Copy /streammonsters/overlay into an OBS browser source. Choose portrait 1080×1920 or landscape 1920×1080, then review renderer quality, safe zones, and the five audio channels with a local demo.
The real overlay URL and every broadcast preview are visible in the Creator.
Stream Monsters 1.8 OBS overlay URL and portrait preview
6. Add the Stream Monsters overlay to OBS
docs.plugin.streamalchemy.steps.rule-res: Review collections, Arena Rating, Collector Score, and the season countdown without changing them. Collections, evolution, levels, and stat points remain permanent across seasons; the documentation check resets no viewer data.
The community view separates seasonal leaderboards from permanent monster progression.
